title: Non-square open-top box
hints: Only the smaller root of $3x^2-26x+40=0$ is in $(0,5)$.
solution: The roots are $(13\pm7)/3$. Only $x=2$ is feasible in the interior. Both endpoints give zero and the interior volume is positive.
statement:
